clips.title: The story
paras: Cragpool Lake is a body of water tucked inside Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Looming above its dark waters sits a massive timber structure erected by the Venture Company.

Nestled within Windshear Crag, Cragpool Lake lies directly beneath the towering logging apparatus built by the Venture Company. An enormous wooden structure spans above the water, serving as the vantage point from which Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle oversees operations across the mountain valley. Venture Company workers occupy the platforms overhead.
